purpose: Resolve the six C2-LT-B7 local-review issue rows into official FDA, CDC, Donate Life and RegisterMe route candidates without changing reviewed artifact or model admission status.

nonClaims: This register does not change any source into reviewed evidence.
This register does not create reviewed artifacts, Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards or downgrade rows.
This register does not authorize model admission, individual advice, individual death-date output, clinical validity claims or intervention ranking.
This register only prepares source-route, duplicate-lineage and dynamic-registration candidates that must pass manual/fulltext extraction and independent fresh review before bounded artifact use.

verificationSources.title: CDC Clinical Guidance for Transplant Safety route
verificationSources.useBoundary: Use only for CDC transplant-safety route identity and duplicate-lineage handling; not for individual transplant eligibility, organ allocation, infection-risk quantification or model admission.

verificationSources.title: FDA Eligibility Determination for Donors of HCT/Ps route
verificationSources.useBoundary: Use only for HCT/P donor-eligibility guidance route correction and manual review planning; not for individual donor eligibility decisions, clinical advice or model admission.

verificationSources.title: Donate Life and RegisterMe donor-registration routes
verificationSources.useBoundary: Use only for donor-registration route metadata, dynamic-route limitations and civil infrastructure context; not for organ availability, allocation, eligibility, outcome or model-admitted claims.

verificationSources.title: FDA xenotransplantation guidance page and guidance index routes
verificationSources.useBoundary: Use only for xenotransplantation guidance route correction and manual review planning; not for feasibility, safety, clinical readiness or model admission claims.

resolutionRows.sourceResolutionDecision: Preserve EXT-019 as the primary CDC transplant-safety guidance route and link EXT-022 as duplicate role-specific provenance instead of independent evidence.

requiredFreshReviewActions: Manually verify CDC transplant-safety page scope, route status and duplicate lineage with EXT-022.
Record whether EXT-019 is the primary source identity and EXT-022 is role-specific organ-donation context.
Prevent duplicate evidence counting before any bounded artifact fill.
